educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) elementary functions, composite functions and inverse functions and those derivatives. (2) the function increase / decrease table and its graph, optimization problem, speed / acceleration, partial differential method. (3) indefinite and definite integrals of elementary functions. (4) area, volume, curve length, and separable differential equation.

activityGoals.body: Be able to draw functions and make increase/decrease tables. Be able to find partial derivatives.
Be able to find indefinite integrals of elementary functions.
Be able to calculate area, volume, and curve length by integration. Be able to solve separable differential equa
Be able to apply calculus to bioscience and chemistry.
Be able to understand English terms in the textbook.
Be able to attend each class and understand the contents of the class. Be able to complete the assignments.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Accurately construct function increase/decrease tables and graphs to accurately solve optimization problems, speed/acceleration, and partial differential problems. (2) Understand the definition of an indefinite integral, as well as related formulas, permutation integral methods, partial integral methods, etc., and accurately calculate the indefinite integrals of elementary functions. (3) Accurately solve problems involving definite integrals, area, volume, curve length, and variable differential equations. (4) Attend every class, understand the contents of the class, and complete all assignments correctly.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Construct function increase/decrease tables and graphs to solve optimization problems, speed/acceleration, and partial differential problems. (2) Understand the definition of an indefinite integral, as well as related formulas, permutation integral methods, partial integral methods, etc., and calculate indefinite integrals of elementary functions. (3) Solve problems involving definite integrals, area, volume, curve length, and variable differential equations. (4) Attend every class, understand the contents of the class, and complete all assignments.
